test_results.name: test_empty_and_whitespace_classification
test_results.verifies: Empty string and whitespace-only queries classify as META_COMMAND with family and reason_code EMPTY_INPUT.

test_results.name: test_meta_command_families
test_results.verifies: All 23 exact meta expressions route to META_COMMAND with correct families (HELP, HISTORY_PANEL, MEMORY_PANEL, SKILLS_PANEL, SETTINGS_PANEL, DIAGNOSTICS_PANEL, HOTKEY_STATUS, EXACT_GREETING, EXACT_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT).

test_results.name: test_meta_command_case_and_punctuation_insensitivity
test_results.verifies: Case variations and trailing punctuation ('Help?', 'HELP!', 'capabilities...', 'hello!') preserve META_COMMAND routing.

test_results.name: test_composite_queries_fail_closed_to_operational_goal
test_results.verifies: Compound indicators ('and', 'then', ';', '&', comma-separated verbs) fail closed to OPERATIONAL_GOAL with reason COMPOSITE_CONTAINS_OPERATIONAL_CLAUSE.

test_results.name: test_operational_goals_classification
test_results.verifies: Workstation actions, computations, queries, observations, and unknown expressions classify as OPERATIONAL_GOAL.

test_results.name: test_envelope_origin_preservation
test_results.verifies: RequestEnvelope origin (CLI, LAUNCHER, RUNTIME), request_id, and dry_run flags are preserved through ingress classification.
